# Open Station Brand

> Brand guidelines for Open Station, the open-source WordPress plugin that turns wp-admin into a desktop OS: windows, a dock, spaces and a command palette on top of WordPress. This file is the machine-readable summary; the visual reference lives at index.html and the structured tokens at brand.json.

The name works on three levels: the space and cosmos territory, the initials hinting at OS, and "Open" saying open source out loud. The visual world is a calm, engineered station in deep space: dark surfaces, neon pulsar accents, holographic meshes, and a small ghost mascot.

## Colors (all named after spatial concepts)

- Pulsar #F252FC (RGB 242, 82, 252): neon identity accent
- Nebula #EC9BFF (RGB 236, 155, 255): soft identity accent
- Starlight #FFFBFF (RGB 255, 251, 255): light contrast
- Astro #19161E (RGB 25, 22, 30): surface dark
- Void #0C0B0F (RGB 12, 11, 15): darkest color, base background

Two named gradient meshes, reserved for hero surfaces:

- Holomesh (soft holographic): assets/holomesh.jpg
- Pulsarmesh (neon magenta): assets/pulsarmesh.jpg

## Typography

- Geist (variable): headlines, UI, body. Display is tight (tracking -0.04em, line height 0.95).
- Geist Mono (variable): labels, metadata, statuses. Small, uppercase, tracking +0.12em.
- Both under SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted: fonts/Geist-Variable.woff2, fonts/GeistMono-Variable.woff2, license at fonts/OFL.txt.

## Logo

- Logomark: assets/logomark.svg (a circle with a fluid blob cut, single color)
- App icon: assets/logomark-app.svg (dark rounded square, radius 113/512, inner shadow 3px 3px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.25), mark inset 18%, optionally filled with a mesh)
- Rule: the logomark and the wordmark ("Open Station", Geist 520, tracking -0.03em) always travel together.
- Construction and clear-space ratios are provisional.

## Mascot

Mio, a small ghost blob that glows in Pulsar and drifts between windows. Named explorations: Luna, Cometa, Órbita, Eclipse, Alba, Nube, Asteroide, Gotita (assets/mio/). Final form and usage rules are still open.

## Files

- [brand.json](brand.json): design tokens (colors, meshes, type, radii, logo rules)
- [assets/](assets/): logomark, app icon, meshes, Mio explorations, merch renders
- [fonts/](fonts/): Geist and Geist Mono variable files plus the OFL license

## Licensing

Open Station is an open-source WordPress plugin (GPL): https://wordpress.org/plugins/desktop-mode/ and https://github.com/WordPress/desktop-mode. Brand assets are meant to be reused; keep attribution sensible and do not present modified marks as official.
